content:
scan-bot: CI SAST scan completed for PR #4821 — 14 findings (2 high). One finding flagged: 'insecure-permission-on-secret-access' in pkg/secret/manager.go. Build logs show KMS decrypt failed twice. <https://ci.internal/runs/4821|ci run>
devon: @scan-bot seeing the KMS decrypt failures — CI env var for the key ARN looks empty on the PR runner. Could be RBAC or secret propagation.
elaine: I can own the SAST triage. Quick question: do logs show 403 (access denied) or 400 (bad request)? That changes the remediation path.
scan-bot: Build log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T10:22:31Z [error] kms: Decrypt failed: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
2026-03-15T10:22:31Z [warning] secret-loader: fallback to empty secret
```

marco: That smells like the RBAC tweak we rolled 03/12. We tightened CI role principals in account-prod. Likely the principal used by PR runners is no longer allowed by the key policy.

elaine: If an RBAC change, we need audit evidence: who changed the role or key policy and when. @paul (sre) can you pull CloudTrail entries for both IAM and KMS around 03/12?

paul (sre): On it. Quick heads-up: we also ran the token-rotation cron that week which touched the CI role binding. Pulling CloudTrail now.

paul (sre): CloudTrail snippets:
```
2026-03-12T03:40:02Z UpdateAssumeRolePolicy by infra-bot (service=sts) on role repo-ci
2026-03-12T03:42:10Z PutKeyPolicy by ops-user on key arn:aws:kms:... (policy unchanged)
```
No explicit kms:Decrypt grant was added. Looks like the role change removed one of the principal ARNs used by PR runners.

linda: For immediate mitigation I propose adding a PR-only runtime flag that disables KMS decrypt and loads a test fixture secret. Safer than widening key policy while we investigate.

devon: I'll open a tiny PR to add `--skip-kms` to the test-runner. That will make SAST/DAST run without failing on PRs. Will not affect prod builds.

elaine: Good. Mid-term we should add a small CI smoke test that verifies `kms:Decrypt` for the CI role and emits a structured audit event we can attach to findings. That way future SAST triage has infra context automatically.

security-oncall: Can we also add detection: if a SAST/DAST finding occurs in the same run as any KMS decrypt error, auto-assign to eng-security and tag `infra-rbac`? That would reduce manual correlation.

marco: We can add correlation logic in the scan orchestrator: attach `evidence:cloudtrail` and `evidence:ci-logs` to the finding and label it when patterns match.

devon: PR 4824 opened: `ci: add --skip-kms for PR runners` — small change, unit tests pass. ETA merge: ~2h.

elaine: I'm creating SEC-492: "CI SAST failure caused by RBAC change affecting KMS decrypt" — I'll include CloudTrail snippets, the failing log excerpt, and suggested RBAC patch. Assigning to myself for the full RCA.

linda: Please add timeline and who approved the 03/12 infra change in the RCA. :memo:

scan-bot: Noted. I will post an automated follow-up to PR #4821 once SEC-492 exists and add a link to CloudTrail evidence.

elaine: Thanks — after the PR merges I'll run the triage write-up and propose a constrained IAM patch: grant `kms:Decrypt` to `arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/repo-ci/*` for the specific key alias rather than the whole account.

devon: Example IAM snippet I'll propose in the infra PR:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/repo-ci/*" }
}
```

paul (sre): After we patch, I'll run a smoke test and add a CI check that validates decrypt before merging infra changes. Also we'll retain CloudTrail retention for 90 days for quick RCA.

elaine: Action items recap (will go in SEC-492):
- immediate: merge PR to skip KMS on PRs (devon)
- short-term: add correlation logic to scan pipeline so SAST alerts auto-attach CI+CloudTrail evidence (marco)
- mid-term: CI decrypt smoke test + gating checks (paul)
- owner: elaine (RCA + mitigation plan)

linda: Thanks. Once RCA is in SEC-492 we'll decide whether to suppress noisy SAST alerts for affected builds or mark them as infra-related.

scan-bot: Follow-up scheduled: will post to PR thread and create an automated finding link when SEC-492 is created.

elaine: I'll update here when PR merges and when I publish the write-up. Appreciate quick responses. :white_check_mark:
